entries.title: Ask HN: What's the most valuable thing you can learn in an hour?
entries.author: newsbinator
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What's the most valuable thing you can learn in an hour?
entries.excerpt: A lot of what hackers do takes years of building knowledge upon knowledge. That's also true for physicists, marketers, salespeople, managers, etc. Are there any quick wins that 30 ~ 60 minutes of intense concentration can generate? For example an average person, if focused, can learn to read (but not understand) Korean decently in under an hour. A person can also learn a few guitar chords and possibly play a carefully-chosen song in that time. But those aren't valuable skills
entries.guide_zh: 集中学习一小时，能够学到哪些最有价值的东西？

entries.title: Tell HN: Google should drop Quora from search results
entries.author: babuskov
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Google should drop Quora from search results
entries.excerpt: Finding answers to basically any question is now behind a walled garden that requires that you create an account. This is the exact thing expertsexchange did before StackOverflow came and ate their lunch. What do you think about it?
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者认为 Quora 的登录墙妨碍查答案，主张 Google 移除其搜索结果。

entries.title: Ask HN: What are you thankful for?
entries.author: japhyr
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are you thankful for?
entries.excerpt: I think this gets asked most years, and I always enjoy the threads that come out of it. I am thankful for a family that I enjoy spending the holidays with. I am thankful that I had a safe childhood and got a good education throughout my life. I am also thankful for the HN community. People dump on this site sometimes, but over most of the past decade HN has been an overwhelmingly positive part of my life. Thank you to everyone for what you bring to the community here.
entries.guide_zh: 年末一起聊聊值得感谢的人和事，以及生活中珍惜的支持。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (November 2019)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please state the job location and include the keywords REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. entries.guide_zh: 2019 年 11 月招聘集中帖，集中展示企业岗位及工作安排。

entries.title: Ask HN: Do you write tests before the implementation?
entries.author: MichaelMoser123
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Do you write tests before the implementation?
entries.excerpt: I mean how many of you stick with this test driven development practice consistently? Can you describe the practical benefit? Do you happen to rewrite the tests completely while doing the implementation? When does this approach work for you and when did it fail you?
entries.guide_zh: 有多少人坚持先写测试，讨论测试驱动开发的实际收益与维护成本。
